Name: Alternative Picture Frames
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10704]Custom Picture Frames[/url]. It requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

It adds five new wall-hanging furniture:

[list]
[*]Triangle 2x2 Frame
[*]Metal 2x2 Frame
[*]Purple 2x2 Frame
[*]Round 2x2 Frame
[*]Island 3x3 Frame

[/list]
To set a picture in a frame, see the documentation for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10704]Custom Picture Frames[/url]﻿.

You can buy the frames at Robin's store for 100 each.

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
